step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates a near real-time ingestion, processing, and predictive analytics pipeline for dialysis clinic data. Data flows from Clinic devices through Kafka into Kinesis Data Streams. A Lambda function splits the stream, pushing raw data into Kinesis Data Firehose and streamed features into Kinesis Data Analytics. A second Lambda interacts with SageMaker to retrieve model predictions, which are written to Elasticsearch for visualization by end-users. S3, Glue, and an On-Prem Data Center are also present on the diagram for offline/batch storage and feature generation.
